hooks.command: input=$(cat); prompt=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.prompt // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$prompt" in *bmad-review-adversarial-general*|*bmad-review-edge-case-hunter*|*"Acceptance Auditor"*) root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -n "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Uncommitted changes in the working tree. Ask the user to commit (or explicitly confirm running review uncommitted) before launching code-review subagents, so the review runs against a clean, stable diff."}}'; fi ;; esac
